meta.title: The Old Bicycle in the Glass Case

paragraphs: On Saturday, the Explorers had a trip to the science museum. They met at the school gate at eight o'clock, and each child had a signed note. Teacher Kim had a list with the names of Lily, Mia, Leo, and May. She counted the children, and everybody was there. The morning was bright, and the air was cool. Mia held her camera, and May held a bottle of water. But the bus did not come.

At ten past eight, the road was still empty. Teacher Kim called the bus office on her phone. "There is a delay on the road," she said. "The bus will come at half past eight." Leo started a word game, and May laughed at his first word. Mia took a photo of the empty road. The children sat on their bags by the wall. Lily looked at her watch many times. Everybody talked about the museum. At half past eight, a blue bus stopped at the gate.

First, the Explorers got on the bus. The seats were soft, and the bus was clean. The journey took forty minutes. Then the bus went past green fields and a wide river. May sat next to the window, and Lily wrote the times in her notebook. After that, the bus crossed a small bridge. At ten past nine, they arrived at the museum.

Guide Ann met them at the door. She wore a white blouse and a dark red scarf. "Welcome," she said. "Today we see the Transport Hall." She gave each child a map with a green cover. The hall was big and cool. On the wall, a long picture showed trains, boats, and planes. Inside the hall, there was a very old bicycle in a glass case. "This is an invention from a long time ago," said Guide Ann. "It has two wheels and a simple wooden frame."

"Where is the engine?" asked Leo. "It has no engine," said Guide Ann with a smile. "The rider pushes the ground with both feet." Mia took a photo of the case, and Lily wrote one word in her notebook: wheels. At noon, they ate lunch under a big tree. Finally, they took the bus home, and they arrived at school at three o'clock. "The bus was late, but the day was good," said May.
text.summary: The Explorers go to the science museum on a Saturday. The bus has a delay, but the children arrive, and Guide Ann shows them the Transport Hall with an old bicycle in a glass case.
